ResourceHeader.Description: Operational Level 2 image data from the Compact Coronagraph-2 (CCOR-2) aboard the SOLAR-1 spacecraft. The data consist of background-subtracted white-light coronagraph images of the solar corona. The images have dimensions of 2048 by 1920 pixels and are provided in FITS format in units of mean solar brightness (MSB). Level 2 products are generated from Operational Level 1A data. The nominal data cadence is approximately 15 minutes.

Parameter.Name: FITS Extension #1 Background-Subtracted White-Light Coronal Intensity Data Array
Parameter.Description: CCOR-2 Level 2 background-subtracted white-light coronal intensity stored in FITS extension #1 as a 2048 x 1920 pixel compressed floating-point image array. The image is expressed in mean solar brightness (MSB) and uses helioprojective solar coordinates with a zenithal polynomial (ZPN) projection. The plate scale is approximately 24.27 arcsec per pixel at the reference point. The reference observation time is specified by the DATE-OBS FITS keyword.
